reviews.title: It’s like the 7700, but different. Read, or the owl will eat you.
reviews.comment: It’s a Ryzen 7, 8c/16t CPU. Unlike the 7700 it has a NPU, but has smaller L3 cache and can only drive 8x on the motherboard’s 16x slot. For me neither the cache nor the PCIe lanes are an issue but do keep those in mind.
reviews.author: JOSEPH N GERTH

reviews.title: Still Perfect for Mid-Range PCs in 2026
reviews.comment: No issues with installing this CPU at all! Been powering my rig for a year now and it's great, not to mention cool to the touch! Perfect for playing video games smoothly and rendering videos fast.
